title: The report guard's model check reads spawns from before a compaction
why: After a compaction, the guard's records hold no spawn from before it, so a Done item that names a pre-compaction reviewer is called wrong whatever its model. Note report-model-before-compact (on #1921): the check fired 4 times in lane session-worktree-strands-agents on reviewers spawned with model sonnet. It may also be the real cause of the no-model-field sightings on step report-guard-role-default-model (lane report-guard-role-default-model, 05:23 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: the guard reads spawn records from before the compaction (the full transcript or the handoff's agent list), or says "unknown" instead of "wrong" for a name it cannot match; red case first on a Done item naming a reviewer spawned before a compaction. Not covered by #1919. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Filed 05:25 CST Nov 8; the coordinator assigns a lane.
